biography: Hello I am Merric, I have served many terms as Blade’s Edge Regent and aspire to be the Kingdom Regent someday! Im mostly known for running board games at NLCC and attempting to play Druid, Archery and artsy stuff. I currently have 7 orders of the dragon mostly for graphic design like recreating heraldries and award templates, which I sped through in my first 2 years of Amtgard and have been stuck at ever since. I hope to get past my hiatus and eventually become a dragon master one day.
